summary: All five claim values were recomputed from raw_data/orders.csv. Each matches the registry and the machine gate. But CLM-NET-CZ states its period as 2025-01-01..2025-02-28, while its value 13527.24 was calculated over the spec period 2025-01-01..2025-03-30. Over the period it states, the value would be 9248.36.
